feeds.title: Military Travel Mama
feeds.description: I am Stephanie - a military spouse and travel and food blogger. I've lived in nine homes in the past ten years due to Uncle Sam. On my blog, you will be reading about our adventures on family trips, dealing with military life - deployments, welcomes, and goodbyes - as well as about working out, healthy eating, military discounts, and parenthood.

feeds.title: Teach.Workout.Love
feeds.description: This is a motherhood community with a passion for writing and being a working mom. T.W.L is an outlet for moms to share their inspirations and creativity in balancing life, motherhood stories, life & style tips, being a military spouse, and staying healthy and fit.

feeds.title: The Stay-at-Home-Mom Survival Guide Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jaimi Erickson. I am glad you stopped by. I love offering you tools that have helped me get my life and family in balance. A complete guide for Stay-at-Home Moms, covering kids' activities, homemaking tips, simple recipes, natural Living, and encouragement for moms to embrace the season of parenting. Authored by Jaimi Erickson.

feeds.title: Organized 31
feeds.description: I believe life is better when organized. Maybe I feel this way because I've moved into and organized 25 houses in 12 states and 3 foreign countries. In addition to organizing, I love to craft, love to repurpose, and love help solves problems. Ideas from a Military Mom with experience in moving, organizing, cooking, crafting and family life.

feeds.title: Seasoned Spouse Blog
feeds.description: I'm a military spouse, a mom of 5 kids, and a published author. I write and speak to encourage and uplift the community of military spouses and loved ones.

feeds.title: For the Love of Food Blog
feeds.description: For the Love of Food is a blog for people who love to eat and love to cook. All the recipes can easily be made at home and are family-friendly and include step-by-step pictures. Most importantly, every post shared on For the Love of Food includes personal photos so the readers can truly connect with Nicole and her family and see that these recipes are cooked from the heart.

feeds.title: Fab Working Mom Life
feeds.description: Welcome! My name is Julie. Helping working moms manage the mental load and work-life balance. Sharing tips and ideas to simplify mom life, and easy activities for busy moms with toddlers and preschoolers.

feeds.title: A Modern Day Fairy Tale
feeds.description: I'm Randi- a Christian, a military wife, a mom of two, a bible journaler, and a lover of books. A Modern Day Fairy Tale is about all of these things and so much more. From recipes and crafts to reviews and giveaways, you'll find it all here!

feeds.title: Three Little Ferns
feeds.description: Hello, and welcome! I'm Alex. I'm a military spouse and mama to three little girls. Currently, our family calls the Newport, Rhode Island area home, but we'll be on the move again next summer. I started this blog in 2012 ago while my husband was deployed to Afghanistan. I wanted an outlet to share my knowledge and ideas about the military and being an Army wife. In the 6 years since starting this blog, I've expanded to include posts about parenting, DIY and craft projects, traveling, and recipes.

feeds.title: Airman to Mom
feeds.description: Sharing the stories of military women past and present. Amanda went from active duty to diaper duty and wants to help empower women veterans and those looking to join the military.

feeds.title: Jessica Lynn Writes Blog
feeds.description: I'm an Air Force wife and mom with three kids currently living in Germany. I'm always planning our next trip and feeding my hungry family with easy meals. If I'm not doing one of those two things, you'll probably find me drinking a second cup of coffee, reading a book, or taking a nap.

feeds.title: Extra Black Olives
feeds.description: Hi, there, Are you in the mood for cat stories, dry, sarcastic humor that doesn't translate well on the Internet, and the occasional recipe? Then you are in the right place. I'm Lisa, the writer of Extra Black Olives. I'm a Jesus fan, Hokie, Alpha Gam, Dr. Pepper addict, Army wife, and crazy cat mom. I'm also a pizza fanatic, student affairs professional, Bigfoot non-believer, and an enthusiastic wearer of bear and moose sweaters.

feeds.title: Stories of Our Boys
feeds.description: Welcome to Stories of Our Boys, a Christian site related to all things motherhood, moving, faith, and occasionally some more girly things. I'm April, a happy and usually tired mother of four boys, ages seven through fourteen. I have been a stay-at-home mom for fourteen years now, so this site gives me a little space to pour my heart out to whoever I can convince to read it.

feeds.title: Loving Life Moore
feeds.description: Hi, My name is Melissa. I created a blog as a sort of diary to chronicle my thoughts and feelings, as well as the journey we were embarking on together. Loving Life Moore is a lifestyle, Travel, and family blog based wherever the Army sends us.

feeds.title: Soldier's Wife, Crazy Life
feeds.description: My name is Julie and I have been a military spouse for 16 years! My husband of 19 years has served in the active-duty Army and is now in the Army National Guard. We have three boys and have been through four deployments together. I hope that you can find support for your own deployments, PCS moves, or anything else military life brings you.

feeds.title: Modern Military Mother Blog
feeds.description: Clare Macnaughton is a modern military mother; a feminist, a British military spouse, and a lifestyle journalist writing about real-life adventures.

feeds.title: The Meat & Potatoes of Life Blog
feeds.description: A blog by Lisa Smith Molinari. Lisa is the Humor columnist, Housewife, Military Spouse, Mom, and Author of The Meat and Potatoes of Life.

feeds.title: The Military Wife and Mom Blog
feeds.description: The Military Wife and Mom blog are so much more than 'it's my way or the highway.' Around here, I give you the tools you need to achieve your goals - whether it's creating a peaceful home and connected relationship with your kids or conquering deployment and building a rock-solid military marriage.

feeds.title: The House of Wood Blog
feeds.description: A self-taught carpenter with a fearless DIY spirit and a penchant for problem-solving, Jen Woodhouse offers in-depth tutorials that inspire and encourage readers to build their way to a more beautiful home. The House of Wood is Jen's creative outlet for all things DIY and design, a place where she documents her adventures in designing and building furniture and tackling home renovation projects. Jen is also a musician, military wife, and homeschooling mother of two.

feeds.title: The Frugal Navy Wife Blog
feeds.description: The Frugal Navy Wife Blog covers articles that help you how to save money on every part of your life from food to DIY, homeschooling, travel, and more. The Frugal Navy Wife is a military wife's guide to savings in civilian life.

feeds.title: Jo, My Gosh! Blog
feeds.description: Military life can be an adventure. It can be full of frustrations and worries, but it's also overflowing with opportunities and joy. ut I learned so much and I'm so excited to share everything with you. The Jo, My Gosh! community is here for you through every deployment and every PCS, through each care package and each video call. You don't have to be alone.

feeds.title: Military With Kids
feeds.description: I'm Jill. I run MilitaryWithKids as a resource and community for military families. I am a military spouse of almost 10 years and a mom of two very active boys. MilitaryWithKids was designed with YOU in mind! Each of us has been tackling the challenge of PCSing, swimming in the fluidity of military spouse careers, constantly changing social networks, navigating Tricare, dealing with deployments, deciphering military lingo all while embracing the advantage of military discount benefits separately

feeds.title: Victoria Terrinoni
feeds.description: Hey there! Hi, I'm Victoria. I followed my Air Force Chaplain, now retired, around the country for 31 years. I am passionate about military spouses, writing about my experiences, being a grandmother of four, and Chicago Bears football!

feeds.title: Pride & Grit
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jennifer Pasquale. Being a military spouse is a source of great pride for many: pride in your country, pride in your Service Member, pride in your community, and on a good day, pride in yourself. I hope you find stories here that speaks to you. Stories that lift you up, make you laugh, inspire you, broaden your perspective, and above all, remind us that there are silver linings in everything.

feeds.title: Glued To My Crafts Blog
feeds.description: Inspiring you to get crafty with easy to follow kid craft tutorials and ideas! With dozens of tips and hundreds of tutorials, you can create one-of-a-kind crafts with us, with little-to-no-craft-skills and really inexpensive supplies!

feeds.title: The Homes I Have Made
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Megan! Among lots of other things, I am most importantly a Mom to three little boys and a proud wife to a US Marine. As a military family, we find ourselves in all sorts of living situations. The Homes I Have Made is where I chronicle my journey of creating home after home, move after move. Alongside anecdotes of our military lifestyle, I primarily share all the clever, affordable, outside-the-box decor and organization solutions we use in our rental homes, most of which can be adapted to any space, any style, and any budget.

feeds.title: Mil Spouse Mama
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Micah. I'm a Jesus-loving, USMC milspouse mama of three boys whom I lug with me all over the world. When asked where I want to visit, I always answer the same: everywhere!

feeds.title: Jen McDonald Blog
feeds.description: As a milspouse of nearly 30 years, I'm also now the mom of an active duty son. We've been through what many military families go through: years of separation due to deployments and TDYs, frequent relocations, separation from extended family, hoping we're doing right in raising our military kids...all of it. Here you will find Hope & humor for military families, raising military kids, strengthening your military marriage, getting through deployments and PCS military moves, and more!

feeds.title: Mrs. Navy Mama
feeds.description: Welcome! My name is Noralee, and I am Mrs. Navy Mama. I am the mother of four beautiful children, and the wife of a Navy officer, and they all keep my life interesting and busy. We move and start over an average of every 2 years and I am here to tell you that it's not always easy, but totally worth it.
